=== Day 2: the town meeting ===
Greta: "I'll put my cards on the table so the rest of you stop squinting at me: I am the Dowser."
Greta: "On day 1, in the afternoon, on the Square I sensed 3 evil among Jory, Dorian, Odette, Lian."
Greta: "This evening, on the Square I sensed 2 evil among Jory, Constance, Agnes, Isolde, Lian."
Greta: "I don't trust Isolde an inch. Constance's reading pointed at them."  [case board: #61, #62, #63, #64]
Agnes: "It troubles me to say it, neighbors, yet I don't trust Greta. Dorian's records tie them to the Poisoner."  [case board: #65]
Constance: "I should mention: Last night, I watched the Market: I saw Isolde pass by."  [case board: #66]
Isolde: "Please hear me gently, everyone—I only held back out of fear, but I am the Lamplighter."

Isolde: "Last night, walking the lamps, I counted 4 others out."  [case board: #67, #68, #69]
Lian: "Here's what the town needs to know to narrow the list: I am the Martyr."
Lian: "Last night, I have given my life over for Isolde, should the town ever hang them."
Lian: "I back Agnes's read on Greta."  [case board: #70, #71, #72]
Isolde: "It pains me, truly, but I share Agnes's fear about Greta."  [case board: #73]
Jory: "Yeah, I'm with Greta on Isolde! I saw them out in the street from my window last night."  [case board: #74, #75]
Odette: "Miraculously, Agnes and I are of one mind regarding Greta."  [case board: #76]
